from datetime import datetime

def find_release_month(title, artist_str):
    # search by title
    result = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=title, page_limit=10)
    hits = result.get('results', result) if isinstance(result, dict) else result
    # artist_str may contain multiple artists separated by comma
    expected_artists = {a.strip() for a in artist_str.split(',')}
    for song in hits:
        if song['title'].lower() != title.lower():
            continue
        actual_artists = {a['name'] for a in song.get('artists', [])}
        # require all expected artists present
        if expected_artists.issubset(actual_artists):
            rd = song['release_date']
            dt = datetime.fromisoformat(rd)
            return f"{dt.month:02d}/{dt.year}"
    return None
